section.title: Dock browser
section.subtitle: Drives the browser in the desktop dock (your persistent signed-in session, not a throwaway Chrome)
field.lookWithoutApproval.label: Look at the dock browser without approval
field.lookWithoutApproval.help: When off, the “take a look” tools (list views, snapshot, screenshot, console and network, wait for text) ask you once each time — they look at **the browser you are signed in to**, so pages may hold sessions and private content. When on, that tier stops raising an approval card; clicking, typing and evaluating still ask every time.
field.about.label: Note
field.about.text: Looking and acting are two tools: browser_dock_look is always available and asks once each time by default (turn the switch on to skip that); browser_dock always asks every time.
look.approvalReason: Take a look at the dock browser (the one you are signed in to): pages may hold sessions and private content, so this one asks you first.
